docTitle: Priya Sharma Senior Hair Stylist Resume
docSummary: Resume covering Priya Sharma’s profile as a senior hair stylist, including skills in balayage, keratin treatments, bridal styling, colour correction and team leadership; Redken and Olaplex certifications; English, Hindi and Gujarati; salon experience at Glow Salon and City Cuts; and a hairstyling diploma.

blocks.text: Senior Hair Stylist · Toronto, ON · 416-555-0199 · priya@example.com

Stylist with 12 years of salon experience across Toronto and Mississauga, leading a team of six and mentoring apprentices. Known for precision cuts and colour correction, with a loyal client base of over 300 regulars.

Glow Salon — Senior Stylist (2019–present)  
Grew colour revenue 40% in two years; introduced the bridal package now sold at $450; trained four apprentices to full-time stylists.

City Cuts — Stylist (2013–2019)  
Managed 30 clients a week; ran the Saturday walk-in desk; expected salary in next role $85,000.

Marvel Beauty School, Diploma in Hairstyling (2012)
Redken Colour Specialist (2021) Olaplex Pro (2022) | now sold at $450; trained four apprentices to full-time stylists. City Cuts - Stylist (2013-2019)
